news.title: A new era: special and inclusive education BA broadens options
news.summary_en: Earlier this year, the Iowa Board of Regents approved a new Bachelor of Arts degree in special and inclusive education. For students who find themselves drawn to this field, it's a new era and opportunity to fulfill dreams and meet an ongoing need.

news.title: Filling gaps in secondary education: the new MAT
news.summary_en: Adult learners ready to transition to teaching in their original subject area of expertise -- like business, math or science -- are finding a new career option with the Master of Arts in Teaching in secondary education.

news.title: Family ties
news.summary_en: Two faculty families -- the Wilsons and the Cryers -- are among those faculty who found a home at University of Northern Iowa and helped shape the history of the College of Education through two generations

news.title: TEACH Studio: A space to learn and collaborate
news.summary_en: More than 30,000 visitors in its first 10 months have discovered the newly refreshed TEACH Studio and all it has to offer -- the outcome of a reimagining of existing space and resources led by a partnership of the Rod Library and the College of Education to create a model school media center and library.

news.title: Len Froyen: A story of gratitude
news.summary_en: Len Froyen has spent a lifetime studying, shaping and sharing a story of gratitude that connect with University of Northern Iowa and, eventually, the College of Education, for nearly half of its 150 years of history.
